title: Yoisaki Kanade — Between Classes〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe I should suppress the bass a little more. Also...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It's already morning...
I am getting a bit hungry, so I think I'll have something to eat.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Instant noodles...?
No, I probably shouldn't have those for breakfast. I don't want to get scolded.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's see... The food Ms. Mochizuki made should be...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A tablespoon of sugar and a dash of soy sauce...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Uh oh. I put in too much.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But a little bit should be fine...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Now I just need to whisk the eggs.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Next, I need to heat up the frying pan.
The one for making omelets should be... Ah, here it is.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Heat it up, pour in the eggs and lightly stir them around...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (When I made those omelets for Dad and he said they were good...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh no...! I need to start rolling it before it starts clumping up...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Uh oh... It's stuck to the pan...
I can't get it unstuck...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
What are you making?
Scrambled eggs?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: S-So... I was trying to make an omelet, but...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Can you make another one, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd like to have breakfast, too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll handle the rice and miso soup.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Do you think I can actually do it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But if you want to, I think you should try.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, I'll give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Alright, I need to crack more eggs...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A piece of shell fell in.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's easy for that to happen if you crack it on the corner of something. You should try using a flat surface.
